## Checklist

- [ ] Limited to one project, one template or the workspace tooling
- [ ] `make check` passes at the root and in the touched folder
- [ ] Tests cover the change, including failure cases
- [ ] No source comments, no email addresses
- [ ] Documentation matches the implementation
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits with the project scope
